advancedAnalytics.title: Clear Visibility
advancedAnalytics.subtitle: See what runs. Know what changed. Decide what happens next.
advancedAnalytics.intro: OmniHub aggregates operational data from your connected systems into unified views. Track what happened, identify where things changed, and make informed decisions based on actual system behavior.

features.title: 360° Operational Visibility
features.description: Gain complete visibility into your operations with unified dashboards and real-time metrics.
features.details: OmniHub aggregates data from all connected systems into a single, comprehensive view. Track KPIs, monitor workflows, and identify bottlenecks across your entire operation in real-time.
bulletPoints: Drill-down capabilities for root cause analysis

features.title: Pattern Analysis
features.description: Analyze historical data to identify trends. Spot anomalies before they become problems.
features.details: Track patterns across time. Compare current behavior to historical baselines. Get notified when metrics diverge from expected ranges. Use what happened to inform what comes next.

features.title: Reporting & Data Export
features.description: Build custom reports from your operational data. Export to any format you need.
features.details: Create reports that match your needs. Schedule automatic generation. Export to Excel, PDF, or integrate with external tools. Your data remains portable.
bulletPoints: Custom report builder with drag-and-drop interface
Export capabilities for Excel, PDF, and standard formats

useCases.title: Executive Performance Dashboards
useCases.description: Consolidate KPIs from sales, operations, finance, and customer success into executive-ready dashboards with real-time updates.

useCases.title: Workflow Performance Optimization
useCases.description: Analyze workflow execution patterns, identify bottlenecks, and receive AI-driven recommendations for optimization.

useCases.title: Customer Journey Analytics
useCases.description: Track customer interactions across all touchpoints to understand behavior patterns, improve experiences, and increase retention.

aiAutomation.title: Portable Automation
aiAutomation.subtitle: You define what happens. The system runs it. You can change it anytime.
aiAutomation.intro: OmniHub executes workflows across your platforms using modular adapters. Define your logic once. Run it consistently. Swap underlying tools without rewriting workflows. Automation stays under your control.

features.title: Deterministic Workflows
features.description: Define business processes that run the same way every time. No surprises.
features.details: OmniHub executes workflows with receipts and idempotency. Same inputs produce same outputs. Errors get caught and logged. You know exactly what ran and what changed.

features.title: Smart Task Orchestration
features.description: Coordinate multi-step processes across platforms with intelligent routing and prioritization.
features.details: The orchestration engine analyzes task dependencies, resource availability, and business priorities to optimize workflow execution automatically.

features.title: Continuous Learning & Optimization
features.description: AI models that continuously improve based on execution patterns and outcomes.
features.details: Every workflow execution generates insights that feed back into the AI models, creating a system that gets smarter over time.

useCases.title: Customer Onboarding Automation
useCases.description: Streamline customer onboarding across CRM, billing, support, and communication platforms with intelligent data routing and validation.

useCases.title: Incident Response Orchestration
useCases.description: Automatically detect, categorize, and route incidents to appropriate teams while coordinating cross-platform notifications and escalations.

useCases.title: Data Pipeline Management
useCases.description: Orchestrate complex data workflows across ETL tools, databases, and analytics platforms with intelligent error recovery and data quality checks.

omniboard.title: OmniBoard
omniboard.subtitle: Third-party provider and SaaS integration gateway.
omniboard.intro: OmniBoard governs SaaS and third-party API connections for Salesforce, Slack, GitHub, Stripe, and more. Manage OAuth handoffs, connector sessions, and credential schemas under a unified compliance layer.

features.title: Universal SaaS Adapters
features.description: Connect Slack, Salesforce, GitHub, and enterprise platforms in minutes.
features.details: OmniBoard handles API authentication, refresh tokens, and rate limits out of the box, ensuring secure and reliable connection states.
bulletPoints: OAuth 2.0 and API Key credential vaulting

features.title: Unified Connection Registry
features.description: Manage and audit all third-party integrations from a single location.
features.details: Track active integrations, monitor throughput, and enforce data mapping rules to prevent sensitive data leakage.
bulletPoints: Active connection auditing and status checks
Encryption at rest for all credentials

features.title: Gateway Availability UX
features.description: Provide clear, honest user states when external APIs are offline.
features.details: OmniBoard detects API network failures, downtime, or rate-limiting blockages and displays detailed diagnostic views.

useCases.title: CRM Data Enrichment
useCases.description: Sync customer records and interaction history from Salesforce into the orchestrator securely.

useCases.title: Slack Notification Gateway
useCases.description: Route governed agent alerts and manual approval prompts to Slack channels with interactive buttons.

useCases.title: Repository Event Ingestion
useCases.description: Listen to GitHub webhook events to trigger automated code quality assessments and CI workflows.

specs.label: Connector Capacity
specs.value: Dozens of pre-built third-party platforms

specs.label: Session Security
specs.value: Encrypted JWT keys, HSM-backed secret storage

specs.label: Event Latency
specs.value: Sub-second webhook propagation and routing

specs.label: Supported Protocols
specs.value: REST, GraphQL, OAuth 2.0, Webhooks

specs.label: Isolation Model

omniSkills.title: OmniSkills
omniSkills.subtitle: Forge, install, and govern expert-level agent capabilities.
omniSkills.intro: OmniSkills are modular, reusable behavioral packages that give your AI agents specific skills and domain expertise. Define skill schemas, run them deterministically, and share skills across your orchestrator instance.

features.title: Skill Forge
features.description: Design and compile custom skills using natural language or structured schemas.
features.details: The Skill Forge translates natural language descriptions into executable skill structures with validation rules, inputs, outputs, and fallback modes.
bulletPoints: Compile skills from natural language descriptions

features.title: Deterministic Execution
features.description: Ensure agent actions are predictable, repeatable, and safe.
features.details: Every forged skill executes within strict policy boundaries, providing execution receipts, audit trails, and automatic error handling.

features.title: Agent Memory Integration
features.description: Connect skills to persistent memory and vector search databases.
features.details: Skills can read and write to partitioned agent memories, enabling continuous learning and knowledge sharing across execution tasks.
bulletPoints: Partitioned state per user or system

useCases.title: Automated Code Auditing
useCases.description: Forge a skill that reads code, checks compliance guidelines, runs tests, and signs off on PRs.

useCases.title: Multilingual Support Assistant
useCases.description: Deploy a customer support skill that integrates translation, knowledge search, and draft generation.

useCases.title: Data Analysis Pipeline
useCases.description: Orchestrate a skill that fetches operational databases, runs statistical analysis, and generates visualization reports.

specs.label: Execution Latency
specs.value: Sub-100ms validation and routing overhead

specs.label: Skill Registry Capacity
specs.value: Unlimited custom skills per instance

specs.label: Supported Frameworks
specs.value: LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, custom MCP servers

specs.label: Memory Integration
specs.value: Supabase Vector, pgvector, Pinecone, local embeddings

byom.title: Connect AI / BYOM
byom.subtitle: Bring Your Own Model. Zero vendor lock-in, total choice.
byom.intro: Connect AI / BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) allows you to connect any LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, or local open-source models) directly into your governed workflows, switching providers with a single toggle.

features.title: Model Independence
features.description: Plug in any LLM provider and switch anytime without rewriting logic.
features.details: OmniHub decouples workflow state from the underlying model provider, allowing you to compare performance, latency, and cost dynamically.
bulletPoints: Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Llama
Local model support via Ollama or custom endpoints
Dynamic load balancing and fallback routing
Zero codebase changes when swapping models

features.title: Governed Prompt Templates
features.description: Store and evaluate system prompts in a secure, audited registry.
features.details: Prompts are managed as code assets under strict version control. All model calls undergo real-time policy checks before execution.
bulletPoints: Versioned prompt registry with template variables
Dynamic evaluation based on user context

features.title: Unified API Gateway
features.description: Proxy all model calls through a single secure ingress with rate limiting.
features.details: Our model proxy handles rate limits, token counting, retry rules, and cost tracking across all provider keys automatically.
bulletPoints: Centralized API key management with encryption
Cost tracking and token usage auditing
Automatic request caching to minimize cost

useCases.title: Multi-Model Fallback
useCases.description: Route lightweight classification to local models while using frontier models for complex planning steps.

useCases.title: Prompt Injection Shielding
useCases.description: Sanitize and validate user inputs before forwarding them to public APIs, protecting enterprise systems.

useCases.title: Enterprise Cost Allocation
useCases.description: Track token usage and expenses per department, application, or workflow run automatically.

specs.label: Proxy Latency
specs.value: <10ms routing and inspection overhead

specs.label: Supported Providers
specs.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, local APIs

specs.label: Security Compliance
specs.value: No data storage on proxy, end-to-end TLS

specs.label: Format Guarantee
specs.value: Enforced JSON Schema outputs via instructor
